interpretation.resampling_unit: Whole matched seed pairs, conditional on one fixed cached candidate pool.
interpretation.bootstrap: Pointwise percentile intervals, not simultaneous intervals; exchangeable seed replicates assumed.
interpretation.sign_test: Two-sided probability of a positive non-tied difference equals 0.5; not a test of the mean difference.
interpretation.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across all 12 archived exploratory endpoint comparisons.
interpretation.auc: Piecewise-linear trapezoidal average over the observed budget range only; intermediate values are interpolated.
interpretation.crossing: Recorded-prefix bounds only; never assign final budget to an unreached target.
interpretation.scope: Post-hoc algorithm-seed sensitivity; no independent experiments or physical-model validation.
